clientName: Mr & Mrs Madeline and Tomasz Szojda
letter:
We are grateful for the opportunity to submit this quotation for your extension works. As discussed, we have made adjustments to the quote to take into consideration the elements discussed during our last meeting. Our commitment is to manage every project effectively to meet our customers' needs, working closely with clients to overcome any unexpected challenges.

Putting the customer first is a core value of our business. We take pride in delivering work of the highest quality while respecting the customer's budget.

Set out below is our quotation and payment schedule, based on the scope discussed at our recent meeting. To start the project we require a 30% deposit inclusive of VAT. If you have any queries, please contact us at info@grbhomeimprovements.co.uk.
scope:
To supply and fix all materials required to carry out the works, in accordance with discussions with the client and the architect's floor plans. A structural engineer's package will be required for Building Control approval.
Soft strip and demolition works as per design, including removal of existing structures and grubbing up of foundations / slab.
Excavate foundation trenches (min. 1000mm), cart away spoil, mass-fill with C30 concrete; brickwork to DPC, cavity infilled.
Supply and install steelwork (beams / padstones / columns) to engineer's design.
Construct new cavity extension walls in blockwork as design; render and make good where bonded to existing.
Form new flat / pitched roof: timber joists and firrings, 18mm OSB deck, single-ply membrane and proprietary trims; new uPVC fascias, soffits and gutters to extension.
Overboard ceilings; board and skim-finish all new / disturbed walls and ceilings.
First and second fix plumbing and heating: new combi boiler, gas upgrade, rads + TRVs, kitchen / utility / WC / bathroom connections.
First and second fix electrics: new fuseboard, sockets, lighting, switching, extract fans and outlets.
Carpentry: skirtings and architraves to match; door linings; install client-supplied doors and ironmongery.
Fix client-supplied wall / floor tiles incl. matting and cement board to wet areas; sub-contract silicone visit.
Internal and external decoration to all affected / elevation areas as specified.
All plant and waste removal for the duration of, and on completion of, the works.
notes:
Local authority fees and provision of drawings to be arranged by the client.
Quotation based on the scope above; any variations will be agreed in writing before proceeding.
This quotation is valid for 60 days from the date above.
